limitations: Income-statement rows are three-month flows in USD thousands, while asset-quality balances are point-in-time stocks in rounded USD millions; their ratios are percentages.

Each filing also presents an adjacent prior quarter, prior-year quarter, percentage variances, and six- or nine-month year-to-date columns. The selected comparison uses the first current-quarter value in each frozen source.

Quarterly GAAP income improved and provision fell, but non-performing loans, non-performing assets, 30-89-day delinquencies, and the past-due/non-accrual total rose. A lower provision alone does not establish improving credit quality or reserve adequacy.
Mortgage-banking income increased while insurance-fee income declined. Total noninterest-income growth should not be described as uniform across every component.
The selected rows do not audit allowance coverage, loan migration, funding mix, capital, all footnotes, or whether revenue and profit changes will persist.

reviews.rationale: Selected GAAP quarterly rows show a sequentially stronger earnings picture: net interest income and net interest income after provision both rose, the credit loss provision declined, noninterest income increased while total noninterest expense declined, and pretax income, net income and diluted EPS all increased. Opposing evidence sits in the point-in-time asset-quality rows: nonperforming loans, nonperforming assets, OREO, loans past due in the shorter bucket, and total past due and non-accrual loans all increased, with the nonperforming-loan and past-due/non-accrual ratios also edging higher, while the longer past-due bucket was unchanged. The earnings improvement and the asset-quality deterioration therefore point in different directions, and the selected rows do not establish whether the lower provision reflects genuinely better credit outcomes or a timing lag relative to the rising nonperforming balances. The tax expense increase is a larger expense, not a smaller drag, and the earnings subtotals are accounting identities rather than causal explanations. Only selected exhibit rows are available: no allowance coverage, net charge-off, loan-growth, net interest margin, non-GAAP reconciliation, guidance or segment detail is in this extract, and nothing here should be read as evidence about what the complete filings omit. Because the selected evidence supports a genuinely mixed view rather than a defensible directional revision, the research state is held for review and the thesis remains blocked pending fuller source evidence.
